import re
from collections import Counter

def top_k_frequent_words(text: str, k: int) -> list[str]:
    if k <= 0:
        return []
    
    # Extract words using regex and convert to lower case
    words = re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', text.lower())
    
    # Count the frequency of each word
    word_count = Counter(words)
    
    # Get the top k most frequent words
    top_k = word_count.most_common(k)
    
    # Extract the words from the top k tuples
    top_k_words = [word for word, count in top_k]
    
    return top_k_words

import re

def clean_phone_number(raw: str, default_country_code: str = "+94") -> str | None:
    # Remove spaces, dashes, dots, and parentheses
    cleaned = re.sub(r'[\s-.\(\)]', '', raw)
    
    # Remove leading '0' and replace with default country code
    if cleaned.startswith('0'):
        cleaned = default_country_code + cleaned[1:]
    
    # Remove '00' and replace with '+'
    cleaned = cleaned.replace('00', '+')
    
    # Verify the number length and format
    if cleaned.startswith('+') and (len(cleaned) < 10 or len(cleaned) > 15):
        return None
    
    # Check for unexpected non-digit characters
    if not cleaned.isdigit():
        return None
    
    return cleaned

import re

def generate_slug(title: str, max_length: int = 50) -> str:
    if not title:
        return ""
    
    # Convert to lowercase
    title = title.lower()
    
    # Replace consecutive non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen
    title = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', title)
    
    # Trim leading and trailing hyphens
    title = title.strip('-')
    
    # Truncate to max_length characters
    if len(title) > max_length:
        words = title.split('-')
        truncated = []
        for word in words:
            if len('-'.join(truncated) + '-' + word) <= max_length:
                truncated.append(word)
            else:
                break
        title = '-'.join(truncated)
    
    return title
